## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (59%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section cannot exclude InSitu [F1] and flags tumor across all four margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 59%, InSitu 41%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Split between Invasive and InSitu |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate Invasive from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100% OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Unflagged despite JPEG 3 degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models match top call |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (74%–80% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors all Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.49) pushes toward invasive (+1.80; AI check 19/20) [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 8, 9) · context · Above-typical (+1.72); descriptive context offsetting invasive score (-1.44; AI check 8/20) [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (-1.29); scarcity pushes toward invasive (+1.04; AI check 20/20) [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-1.42) pushes toward invasive (+1.01); caption-inconsistent (AI check 18/20) · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · High score (+1.53) adds +0.99, but failed AI check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score more than random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses (+0.99), normal lobules (+0.95), necrosis (+0.41).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated frozen-section JPEG severity 3 artifacts or TILs mimic invasion over InSitu (contrast case BACH_0063, 68% similarity).
- Small-cohort calibration (ECE 5%, 24 patients) or reliability (70% error AUROC) misses errors while cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 3, 0, 1**: Inspect highest-risk regions (75%, 60%, 59%, 46%) for true stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 0, 6, 9, 10**: Compare infiltrating-stroma regions (0, 6, 9) against duct-confined region 10 and TIL-rich regions 4, 8, 9.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Verify tumor at inferior (645 um), superior (430 um), medial (323 um), and lateral (323 um) margins.
